issues.legal_issue: Deletion of a rule prescribing how compensation property is allocated does not alter rights in a pending dispute when the rule governed the dispute and the deletion was not retrospective.
material_facts: A government-built shop was occupied by competing claimants seeking transfer of the property as compensation.
The applicable rules extended the allocation method for acquired evacuee property to government-built property, so far as applicable.
The allocation rule directed that property occupied by multiple verified claimants be offered to the claimant with the highest gross compensation.
An authority allotted the shop to the claimant with the higher gross compensation while the allocation rule was in force.
The competing claimant’s challenge remained pending when the allocation rule was deleted, and a later review authority applied the amended rules to order the property sold.
The amendment deleting the rule did not expressly or impliedly provide for retrospective operation.
issues.conclusion: The deletion did not affect the parties’ rights in the pending dispute, which were governed by the allocation rule in force when the dispute arose.
issues.legal_principle: A rule prescribing the form and manner in which compensation is payable can form part of the substantive right to compensation, rather than merely regulate procedure. Rule 30 of the Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Rules, 1955 prescribed allocation by reference to the claimants’ gross compensation; Rule 43 extended Rules 25 to 34, so far as applicable, to transfers of government-built property. Under the Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1954, and the Rules, a displaced person’s right to compensation includes its prescribed form and manner. A substantive right is not taken away by an amendment absent express or implied retrospective operation. The Court approved the principle stated in Pt. Dev Raj v. Union of India, A.I.R. 1974 Pun. 65.

rule.if: compensation_property_allocation_proceeding and dispute_arose_while_allocation_rule_operated and allocation_rule_ranked_claimants_by_compensation and proceeding_pending_when_rule_deleted and not deletion_made_retrospective

predicates.compensation_property_allocation_proceed: The proceeding concerned competing claims to transfer of property as compensation.
predicates.dispute_arose_while_allocation_rule_oper: The competing claims arose while the allocation method was in force.
predicates.allocation_rule_ranked_claimants_by_comp: The applicable allocation method directed that the property be offered to the claimant with the highest gross compensation.
predicates.proceeding_pending_when_rule_deleted: A challenge concerning the competing claims remained pending when the allocation method was removed.
predicates.deletion_made_retrospective: The amendment expressly or impliedly stated that removal of the allocation method applied retrospectively.

issues.definition: When a compensation-property allocation dispute arose under an operative method that ranked claimants by compensation, remained pending when that method was removed, and the removal was not retrospective, the earlier method governs the dispute.
